title: Evolving Skill Modules under a Fixed Planner: Versioning, Rollback, and Runtime Governance for Long-Lived Robot Systems
abstract: arXiv:2604.07799v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robots deployed for long periods keep improving their skills, and each update changes a released system. We treat this as a software-lifecycle problem: a fixed decision layer dispatches versioned skill modules and a runtime layer was built to screen each action. On six robosuite tasks we report three negative results and two measurements. First, peak task success is unstable across random seeds (within one method it spans 23.3 to 73.3%), so single-run peaks cannot rank these methods. Second, the system's four modules are whole-task policies with different labels, rotated on a clock, not the phase decomposition its documentation describes. At a matched budget one such policy holds the geometry at the final step in 0.734 of episodes reaching it, averaged over seeds, against 0.023 for the rotation, with no seed overlap at four seeds per arm (exact p=0.029). An intervention isolates why: restoring the termination condition the cloc

translated_title: 固定规划器下的技能模块演化：面向长寿命机器人系统的版本管理、回滚与运行时治理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.07799v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：长期部署的机器人会不断改进其技能，而每一次更新都会改变一个已发布的系统。我们将此视为一个软件生命周期问题：由一个固定的决策层来调度带版本号的技能模块，并构建了一个运行时层来审查每一个动作。在六个 robosuite 任务上，我们报告了三个负面结果和两项测量。首先，任务成功率的峰值在不同随机种子之间不稳定（同一方法内部跨度为 23.3% 至 73.3%），因此单次运行的峰值无法用于对这些方法进行排序。其次，系统的四个模块实际上是带有不同标签的整任务策略，按固定时钟轮换运行，而非其文档所描述的阶段分解。在匹配预算条件下，其中一个这样的策略在到达最后一步的回合中，以跨种子平均 0.734 的比例保持几何结构，而轮换方式仅为 0.023，且在每组四个种子的设置下无种子重叠（精确 p=0.029）。一项干预实验隔离了原因：恢复时钟的终止条件……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将长期运行机器人的技能持续更新视为软件生命周期问题，提出由固定决策层调度带版本的技能模块并用运行时层审查动作，同时通过实验揭示了单次峰值成功率不可靠、所谓阶段分解实为按钟轮换的整任务策略等负面结果。
en_tdlr: This paper frames long-lived robot skill evolution as a software-lifecycle problem, using a fixed planner to dispatch versioned skill modules with runtime screening, and reports negative results showing that single-run peak success is seed-unstable and that the system's modules are clock-rotated whole-task policies rather than the claimed phase decomposition.
